method: Live Developing Themes override. Ranks use freshness/materiality plus current cross-asset significance. Old themes phase down when transmission weakens; headline attention has zero direct score weight without verification.
headlineRead: The Sep 5 hierarchy changed after August payrolls materially beat expectations and prior months were revised higher. Resilient jobs/services demand plus record diesel and hot ISM prices put Fed/long-end risk back at #1. Refined-product/Hormuz inflation remains #2. Copper tariff/inventory geography jumps to #3 as ex-US visible buffers tighten. AI/power long-lead capex remains structurally dominant but is less fresh than the jobs/copper changes. Gold is demoted tactically after yields/USD rose. A new Physical-Operations Software theme phases in after Samsara's 30% revenue/ARR growth and fourth consecutive GAAP-profitable quarter.

newThemes.name: AI Memory Scarcity / Supply-Response Clock
newThemes.summary: HBM, server DRAM and enterprise SSD remain scarce and profitable, but record memory-equipment spending means peak scarcity margins should not be annualised indefinitely.
newThemes.whyNow: Near-term memory/electronic component scarcity remains official ISM evidence, while later supply additions create the main cycle risk.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Near-term pricing supports MU/SKHY/SNDK; later capacity can compress margins if bit supply outruns workload growth.
newThemes.nextTest: Can 2027-29 capacity additions be absorbed without material pricing deterioration?
newThemes.watchlistAction: Prefer HBM/server/enterprise exposure and use cycle-aware valuation.

newThemes.name: AI Advanced Packaging / Substrates
newThemes.summary: Advanced packaging remains a genuine AI bottleneck, especially where customers directly fund capacity.
newThemes.whyNow: Customer prepayments/LTAs provide stronger demand evidence than speculative capacity announcements.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Packaging can constrain accelerator/HBM shipments even when wafer capacity is available.
newThemes.nextTest: Does new capacity fill with contracted AI/HPC demand?
newThemes.watchlistAction: AMKR remains a second-order scarcity play.

newThemes.name: AI Optical Migration / Silicon Photonics
newThemes.summary: AI clusters continue moving more data over optical links as copper reach, bandwidth and power limits worsen.
newThemes.whyNow: Capacity ramps/customer commitments show optical migration is booked rather than merely conceptual.
newThemes.marketTransmission: More optical content per rack benefits lasers, transceivers, photonics and networking suppliers.
newThemes.nextTest: Do optical shipments/margins keep rising as copper hits practical limits?
newThemes.watchlistAction: Selective only; concentration and valuation matter.

newThemes.name: Copper Ex-US Inventory Squeeze / Tariff Distortion
newThemes.summary: Tariff-driven US refined-copper stockpiling is draining visible supply from other markets while LME and Shanghai buffers tighten near record prices.
newThemes.whyNow: The price move is increasingly backed by inventory geography rather than a generic electrification narrative: US inventories are absorbing metal while ex-US buffers thin.
newThemes.marketTransmission: Supports miners and scarce electrical equipment pricing power while raising costs for cable, transformer and low-margin fabrication users.
newThemes.nextTest: Do ex-US inventories keep falling after tariff/arbitrage flows mature?
newThemes.confirmation: Persistent backwardation and falling LME/Shanghai stocks.
newThemes.watchlistAction: FCX staged near $70-72; BHP for diversified exposure; do not annualise squeeze pricing.

newThemes.name: Physical-Operations Software / Industrial IoT
newThemes.summary: Samsara gives Power Stack a differentiated software expression tied to fleets, construction, logistics and real-world industrial operations rather than generic seat-based SaaS.
newThemes.whyNow: Q2 FY2027 revenue and ending ARR both grew 30%, net-new ARR grew 28%, >$1M customers generated more than $500M ARR, and GAAP profitability extended to a fourth consecutive quarter.
newThemes.marketTransmission: If industrial/fleet customers standardise on connected operations, software monetisation can compound alongside physical capex without requiring humanoid adoption.
newThemes.nextTest: Establish IOT valuation/retest zone and confirm Q3 guidance/cash conversion.
newThemes.confirmation: Large-enterprise ARR and margins continue compounding.
newThemes.invalidation: Growth/margins decelerate faster than valuation compresses.
newThemes.watchlistAction: IOT NEW PRIORITY RESEARCH; do not chase post-earnings gap.

long-end-duration-stress.name: Resilient Jobs/Services + Hot Inflation / Fed & Long-End Risk
long-end-duration-stress.summary: The macro constraint is no longer simply long-duration valuation pressure. August payrolls +162k, upward revisions, ISM Services 55.4/Prices 72.6 and record diesel combine resilient demand with persistent inflation, pushing yields and hike pricing higher again.
long-end-duration-stress.whyNow: The Sep 4 payroll surprise reversed part of the prior Waller relief and raised the hurdle rate for long-duration and leveraged projects.
long-end-duration-stress.marketTransmission: Higher 2Y/10Y yields and USD pressure growth multiples, housing and gold tactically while rewarding current cash flow/pricing power.
long-end-duration-stress.confirmation: Sticky inflation plus resilient jobs keep long yields high.
long-end-duration-stress.invalidation: Inflation cools sharply and jobs weaken without credit stress.
long-end-duration-stress.watchlistAction: Prefer current cash flow and pricing power; avoid unfunded duration.

refining-product-inflation.summary: Record US diesel and depressed Hormuz traffic keep middle distillates as the strongest immediate energy-inflation channel, even as crude remains below peak war levels.
refining-product-inflation.whyNow: US diesel is roughly $5.85/gal while Brent settled $92.68 and WTI $91.48; product scarcity is transmitting directly into freight/agriculture/consumer costs.
refining-product-inflation.marketTransmission: Supports integrated/refining earnings and inflation expectations while eventually creating demand destruction.
refining-product-inflation.watchlistAction: Quality energy/refiners only; no chase on geopolitical premium.

ai-physical-bottlenecks.summary: Official ISM evidence continues to confirm transmission/generation material purchasing and long-lead planning; real AI/power capex remains one of the strongest structural Power Stack mechanisms.
ai-physical-bottlenecks.watchlistAction: PWR/ETN/GEV/VRT preferred; require funded projects and entry discipline.

ai-time-to-power-microgrids.watchlistAction: VRT remains the preferred direct expression; monitor valuation and funded deployments.

ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.summary: AI demand is real, but requested MW remain weaker evidence than deposits, named customers, orders, backlog, revenue and FCF, especially with yields rising again.
ai-load-quality-ghost-demand.watchlistAction: Maintain demand-evidence ladder; punish unfunded queues.

software-relative-strength.summary: Selective AI software/cyber monetisation remains valid, but higher yields again make cash conversion and valuation more important than broad SaaS beta.

fertilizer-feedstock-divergence.watchlistAction: CF quality thesis intact but no chase; NTR more deferable input mix and current entry less attractive.

gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.summary: Gold's Sep 3 tactical confirmation weakened after payrolls pushed yields and the dollar higher; structural fiscal/geopolitical hedge logic remains intact.
gold-precious-metals-reconfirmation.watchlistAction: Stage only; wait for PPI/CPI/real-yield confirmation.

uranium-fuel-cycle.watchlistAction: CCJ/LEU/BWXT preferred to pre-commercial reactor duration.
